\title{Fast Exponential Smoothing \\ for Streams}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We present an online smoother with $O(1)$ updates.
\end{abstract}

\section{Method}
Let $x_t$ be the input. % a comment with \begin{equation} inside
The smoothed value is
\begin{equation}
  s_t = \alpha x_t + (1 - \alpha) s_{t-1} \label{eq:update}
\end{equation}
with $0 < \alpha \le 1$.
\[ \lim_{t \to \infty} s_t = \mu \]

\begin{theorem}
For bounded inputs, $\min_i x_i \le s_t \le \max_i x_i$.
\end{theorem}
